existing_proofs_preserved: The complete dequantization kernel is proved for signed int8 weights, fp32 scales and fp16/bf16/fp32 output, including distinct weight and scale masks, two-dimensional offsets, signed integer semantics, active values and frame. Index-only candidate equivalence has no numerical rewrite assumption. All mathematical block shapes are parameters.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Full dequantization stage and both K/N masks are represented.
Dimension/contiguity assertions, optional destination, fp_b allocation, full dequantization grid and subsequent torch.mm are not composed.

dtype_review: The source name suggests int8 but Python does not enforce b=int8, scale=fp32 or a in three output storage types. Formal dequantization is specifically those types; additional admitted b/scale/a conversions and matrix-multiply dtype choices remain outside it.
branch_review: Both out=None and supplied-out branches are original program behavior. The source torch.mm uses a and completed fp_b after the Triton stage; no public declaration includes that computation. Config variants are not themselves missing when their block dimensions are already parametric.

structural_gaps.finding: Python calls torch.mm(a,fp_b,out=c) after dequantization, whereas public output formula is only int-weight times scale.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: This is an entire omitted original stage, including A-dependent outputs; no numerical assumption can replace the missing matrix-multiply graph/composition.

structural_gaps.finding: Wrapper checks dimensions/contiguity, chooses a new or supplied c, allocates fp_b and composes a two-dimensional dequantization launch.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The public per-tile dequantization theorem does not establish either wrapper return branch or error behavior.

structural_gaps.finding: TypedSource fixes b_ptr=int8, b_scale_ptr=fp32 and only three output types; original wrapper does not enforce those restrictions.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Represent actual supported load/promotion/store and matmul dtype routes or precise admission/rejection contracts before claiming complete original dtype scope.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Within represented dequantization routes, multiplication and output rounding may be deferred. A future matrix-multiply numerical obligation is separate from the presently absent stage, which must first be modeled.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
